observations: Garage source views show horizontal concrete bands, vertical supports and dark open bays.
Contractor project photograph shows concrete parapets, steel beams and fine metal grid at open perimeter bays; exact correspondence of that photograph is project-associated, not surveyed.
Utility source views show largely closed pale walls, a west-end door and a small feature on the long north wall.

DOP20 resolves two pale circular structures beside the utility west/south corner; DOM20 resolves separate cap plateaux around 480.92m and 480.82m UTM elevation. Function, pipework, lower supports and precise cap profile are unverified.
qualification: Private source projections reviewed for all 32 garage and six utility wall faces. Coverage/occlusion varies greatly; no provider or contractor pixels bundled. Garage bay widths, floor pitch, rail spacing, depth, colours and obscured details are estimates. Utility doors/joints approximate. No interiors; parking bays use shallow exterior recesses.
